title: Checking Existence of Edge Length Limited Paths II
summary: Build a query structure over a weighted undirected graph: query(p, q, limit) returns true when p and q are connected using only edges with weight strictly less than limit.
inputFormat: An n-node graph with an edge list of [u, v, w]; queries take p, q and limit.
tieRules: Edges with weight equal to the limit are forbidden (strictly less).
edgeRules: Whether the graph may be disconnected, have duplicate edges or self-loops is not recorded.

examples.label: authored-reference
examples.note: Authored; relies on the strict less-than rule.

factsMissing: Whether duplicate edges or self-loops occur
questions: What is the exact constructor signature for the graph and edge list?
